text:
maya: FYI hitting a weird client-side failure in the sampleapp during warmup. Prefill is enabled and the paginator kicks off a bunch of concurrent requests while token refresh races. Result: client circuit opens and we see sustained 429/503s.

samir: Ugh. Can you paste the config and a short log slice? Which SDK/version?

maya: Using js-sdk v0.12.3 (same behavior on latest main locally). Config snippet:
```json
{
  "prefetch_count": 6,
  "page_size": 25,
  "concurrency": 8,
  "token_refresh_window_s": 20
}
```
Log excerpt (trimmed):
```
2026-03-18T10:12:03Z ERROR client circuit open: failing fast
2026-03-18T10:12:04Z WARN request failed 429 Too Many Requests route=/generate model=redwood-1a
2026-03-18T10:12:05Z INFO token refresh started
2026-03-18T10:12:06Z ERROR token refresh failed: 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-18T10:12:07Z WARN request failed 503 Service Unavailable route=/embed
```
This happens pretty much immediately during the onboarding warmup step where we prefill caches.

alex: Do we see the same in Go SDK? I remember a parity gap where Go had jittered backoff on 429s and JS didn't. Could be amplification: prefetch makes N parallel requests, one token hiccup causes retries that align and trip the circuit.

ben: Nice catch. If you can repro, try lowering prefetch_count to 2 or set concurrency to 2 as a quick mitigation. Also increase token_refresh_window_s to 60 so refresh happens earlier (avoid mid-prefill refresh).

maya: Confirmed lowering prefetch fixes it locally. But this is bad DX for new users—default sampleapp uses prefetch=6. New teams see failures on first-run and blame Redwood.

samir: Can you open a small repro repo/steps? We should also check sdk parity: JS backoff seems deterministic (no jitter) in its exponential backoff, so many clients retry simultaneously.

alex: I can take SDK parity look. Quick notes: js-sdk retry.js uses fixed exponential with factor 2, base 500ms, max 10s (no jitter). go-sdk has full jitter implemented.

ben: For product fix options: 1) change sampleapp defaults to conservative prefetch/concurrency, 2) add jitter in js-sdk retry, 3) make prefill opt-in with big warning, 4) adjust onboarding script to warm sequentially instead of parallel.

maya: Repro steps I used:
1) npm run start-sampleapp (uses defaults)
2) trigger /onboard which does prefill in parallel (6 pages)
3) watch logs; token provider simulates occasional 502s (we've seen this in staging)

alex: I'll open an RFC for jitter + SDK parity tag and link to this thread.

samir: Also adding telemetry item: instrument 'prefill_failure' metric and sampleapp should emit a tip when prefill fails that suggests lowering prefetch.

maya: For immediate help, can you add a one-line comment in the onboarding README pointing users to set PREFETCH_COUNT=2? I'll submit a PR after lunch.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy of sampleapp v0.3.1 scheduled at 2026-03-18T14:00Z.

ben: +1 to PR. Also create an issue to audit default sample configs across SDK examples.

alex: I'll post SDK diff and link when ready.

maya: Thanks all — will attach the repro repo once I clean it up.
